claim: Pass-through: token counts incl. cached tokens are decided by upstream, not the gateway

code_paths_confirmed.passthrough: OpenAI chat/responses relay upstream usage unchanged when present
code_paths_confirmed.local_fallback_only: ResponseText2Usage only when upstream usage missing (TotalTokens==0) — necessary billing fallback, not override

remaining_optional.CountToken=false: skips pre-consume local estimation (minimal pre-charge, settle on upstream) — ops trade-off, documented in deployment-sop
remaining_optional.include_usage: stream_options.include_usage=true for supported stream channels — upstream usage in stream tail, not first-token latency
